appearances.title: Hy4 flash open weights get day-0 vLLM support
appearances.summary: Tencent's Hy4 flash, a 224B open-weight model with 12B active parameters, a 1 million token context, and native multimodal input, now has day-0 support in vLLM for documents, slides, and computer use. OpenCode is also offering Hy4 flash free for the next 10 days.
